verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a public website and a developer portal, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. The probe of https://www.uscis.gov/llms.txt returned HTTP 403, and nothing in the pack shows an agent-oriented docs index. The Torch developer portal offers conventional API docs with accounts, keys and a sandbox, but these are not agent-oriented documentation and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
